rui_ro: (a) Neu KHONG dong bo client: client van tu tinh relation bang bang cu -> co the khong cho bam danh nguoi bang khac/cay (client loc click) du server coi la dich. Phai test; neu client chan thi buoc 4 la bat buoc. (b) Quen reset TmpCamp khi roi map: DelPlayer2List goi SetTmpCamp(0) + OnLeaveWorld ban khi logout (KPlayerSet.cpp:374) -> OK; nhung neu server crash giua chung thi TmpCamp KHONG persist (truong runtime) -> an toan. (c) NPC ve binh/cay: SetTmpCamp(1, idx) - NPC khong co FightMode, dieu kien chi doi FightMode voi kind_player -> dung. (d) Nguoi choi cung bang nhung KHONG bat chien dau (FightMode 0): khong ap override -> roi ve bang thuong (giong Linux).

C++ co du: KItem::GetStackNum/SetStackNum/IsStack/GetMaxStackNum (KItem.h:311-312,403-409); KItemList::SyncItem(nIdx) (dung trong KItemList.cpp:1815 sau SetStackNum) de day so luong moi xuong client; KItemList::SearchID de kiem item thuoc nguoi choi; RemoveItemByIndex da co (KJx2WarInfra.cpp:741).

int LuaGetItemStackCount(Lua_State* L){ if (Lua_GetTopIndex(L)!=1){Lua_PushNumber(L,-1);return 1;} int n=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,1); if(n<=0||n>=MAX_ITEM||Item[n].GetIndex()<=0){Lua_PushNumber(L,-1);return 1;} int c=Item[n].GetStackNum(); if(c<1)c=1; Lua_PushNumber(L,c); return 1; }
int LuaSetItemStackCount(Lua_State* L){ int nP=GetPlayerIndex(L); if(Lua_GetTopIndex(L)!=2||nP<=0){Lua_PushNumber(L,-1);return 1;} int n=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,1); int c=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,2); if(n<=0||n>=MAX_ITEM||c<1||c>Item[n].GetMaxStackNum()){Lua_PushNumber(L,-1);return 1;} Item[n].SetStackNum(c); Player[nP].m_ItemList.SyncItem(n); Lua_PushNumber(L,1); return 1; }  // dat o KJx2WarInfra.cpp canh LuaRemoveItemByIndex, dang ky ScriptFuns.cpp canh 14922.
rui_ro: guard.lua:66-71: neu stack>1 thi SetItemStackCount(stack-1) else RemoveItemByIndex. Item 3822 du an nMaxStack = 50 (cot 13) -> stack duoc. KHONG kiem tra item co thuoc nguoi choi (Linux cung khong) - item index tu main(nItemIndex) la cua nguoi dung.

ngu_nghia: localtime(&t) (0x804b72c); neu tm_isdst==1 thi t -= 3600 va localtime lai (0x08103A58) roi ep isdst=0. Mang ket qua [ebp-0x3c..]: [1]=tm_year+1900, [2]=tm_mon+1, [3]=tm_mday, [4]=tm_hour, [5]=tm_min, [6]=tm_sec, [7]=tm_wday (0=CN), [8]=tm_yday+1. Push lan luot nCount so dau.
tuong_duong_jx1: KHONG co. GetLocalDate(fmt) (ScriptFuns.cpp:3212) chi tra CHUOI theo strftime cua gio hien tai, khong nhan epoch.
cach_viet: int LuaMakeDateTime(Lua_State* L){ int nTop=Lua_GetTopIndex(L); int nCount=6; if(nTop>=1){nCount=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,1); if(nCount<1||nCount>8) return 0;} time_t t=time(NULL); if(nTop>=2) t=(time_t)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,2); struct tm* p=localtime(&t); if(!p) return 0; int v[8]={p->tm_year+1900,p->tm_mon+1,p->tm_mday,p->tm_hour,p->tm_min,p->tm_sec,p->tm_wday,p->tm_yday+1}; for(int i=0;i<nCount;i++) Lua_PushNumber(L,v[i]); return nCount; }  // ScriptFuns.cpp canh LuaGetLocalDate:3212, dang ky {"MakeDateTime", LuaMakeDateTime}

chu_ky: AddTimer(nFrames, szFunName, nParam) -> nTimerId (>0) | 0. gettop phai >= 3 (0x08100D5A); lay script id hien tai (0x8220780 = id cua script dang chay); nFrames = tonumber(1) (fistp), szFunName = tostring(2) (rong -> 0), nParam = tonumber(3). Tao timer (0x81cda80), init(timer, scriptId, szFun, nParam) (0x81cc520: +4 = ten ham[0x103], +0x108 = scriptId, +0x10c = nParam), dang ky vao quan ly 0x82e8cac voi 0x804e470(mgr, timer, nFrames) -> id (so thu tu tang dan, 0x081CC592 add ebx,1), fire = GameTime[0x9777f00] + nFrames. DelTimer(nTimerId) huy.
ngu_nghia: Khi den han (vtable[0] 0x081CC300): pScript = g_GetScript(scriptId) (0x805d080); push (nParam [+0x10c], nTimerId [+0x110]) roi goi ham TEN (ho tro 'Bang:Ham') qua 0x8221ed0(pScript, szFun, 2 tham so, &nRet); neu tra >= 2 gia tri: v1 = tonumber(-2) -> neu == 0 thi ket thuc timer, khac 0 thi dat lai nFrames = v1 (0x081CC42A ghi [edi] = khoang ke tiep) va nParam = tonumber(-1) -> timer LAP LAI. Tra < 2 gia tri -> huy timer. Don vi nFrames: 18 = 1 giay (tongcastle: 60*18 = 60 s).
tuong_duong_jx1: KHONG co timer toan cuc theo ten ham. SetTimer/StopTimer (ScriptFuns.cpp:2666-2681) la timer CUA NGUOI CHOI (KPlayer::SetTimer) ; TM_SetTimer la stub tra 0 (2240). Co san KJx2GlbTimer (KJx2League.cpp:955-1236: StartGlbMSTimer(missionKey, timerTaskId, frames) goi OnTimer cua script trong settings\TimerTask.txt moi chu ky) - mau nhip tick CoreServerShell.cpp:1172.
cach_viet:
Them vao KJx2League.cpp (canh s_GlbTimers): struct KJx2ScriptTimer{int nId; char szScript[MAX_PATH]; char szFun[128]; int nParam; DWORD dwNextMs;}; static std::vector<KJx2ScriptTimer> s_ScriptTimers; static int s_nScriptTimerNext=0;
int LuaAddTimer(L): nTop>=3 else push 0; KLuaScript* pCur = script dang chay (lay tu g_GetScript theo L: duyet g_ScriptSet tim m_LuaState==L, hoac them ham tien ich g_GetScriptByState(L)); nFrames=tonumber(1) (<1 -> 1); szFun=tostring(2) (rong -> push 0); nParam=tonumber(3); t.nId=++s_nScriptTimerNext; t.dwNextMs=GetTickCount()+nFrames*1000/18; push t.nId.
int LuaDelTimer(L): xoa theo id, push 1/0.
void KJx2ScriptTimer_Breathe(): (goi ngay sau KJx2GlbMission_Breathe() o CoreServerShell.cpp:1172) gom cac timer den han; voi moi cai: pScript=g_GetScript(szScript); sprintf(sz,"return %s(%d,%d)", szFun, nParam, nId); SafeCallBegin; int nTop0=Lua_GetTopIndex; lua_dostring(pScript->m_LuaState, sz); int n=Lua_GetTopIndex-nTop0; if(n>=2 && (int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,-2)!=0){ t.dwNextMs += frames(-2); t.nParam=(int)Lua_ValueToNumber(L,-1); } else xoa timer; SafeCallEnd.
Dang ky {"AddTimer",LuaAddTimer},{"DelTimer",LuaDelTimer}.
rui_ro: (1) lua_dostring voi 'return f(a,b)' de lay gia tri tra - chunk top-level return hop le Lua 4 (leaguematch head.lua:4-6 da dung). (2) Xoa/them timer TRONG callback (OnTime khong lam) - gom danh sach truoc khi goi nhu KJx2GlbMission_Breathe. (3) Neu KHONG muon lam engine: stub `function AddTimer() return 1 end` trong state chu + driver goi TongCastle:OnTime moi 60 s - nhung BH2/LD3 cung can AddTimer nen nen lam engine.

ham: RemoteExecute (GS ELF 0x08100740; relay 0x0810363A) - RPC GS<->relay qua ObjBuffer
chu_ky: RemoteExecute(szScript, szFun, hParam [, szCallBackFun, nCallBackParam [, dwGameSvrId]]) -> 1 neu gui duoc, 0/nil neu loi. gettop phai >= 3 (0x08100757 cmp eax,2 jle); szScript=tostring(1), szFun=tostring(2) (rong -> push 0), hParam=tonumber(3) >= 0; hParam tra trong std::map handle->buffer (0x9780ce4) (0x08100846-0x08100897); gettop==3 -> khong callback (0x081008B5), >3 -> cbFun=tostring(4), cbParam=tonumber(5).
ngu_nghia: Dong goi GOI MANG (0x08100908: byte 1, 0x3d = ma goi, len script, len fun, len buffer) toi da 0x8000 byte (0x081008E9) chua script+fun+noi dung ObjBuffer (+ ten callback + param) gui sang tien trinh kia (relay hoac GS). Ben nhan: tao handle moi tu noi dung, goi szFun(hParam [, hResult]) ; neu co callback thi gui nguoc goi ket qua ve: cbFun(nCallBackParam, hResult) trong SCRIPT GOC (lib/remoteexc.lua:23-30 xac nhan chu ky callback (Param, ResultHandle)).
